🔥 The fire settles. Bran has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Jovan says "So it bleeds." Rafael says "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

Antibiotics end it; skilled wound care (triage, field medicine) can turn it — but only if you know what you're treating. (Antibiotics would end it.) The ruins to the east sometimes still hold medicine cabinets — worth searching. — diagnosed by Hunter.
